copy.tagline: 把 Discord 机器人频道接入你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要为应用添加 Discord 机器人频道
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Discord bot channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to connect Discord bot channels to your application

howto.what: 装上后，助手会通过 Chat SDK 多出一条 Discord 机器人通道：机器人可与你私聊，也能在共享服务器的文字频道里收发消息；支持线程。
howto.when: 当你明确要求接入 Discord 机器人频道，或在 /setup 流程中选择添加 Discord 通道时，本技能会执行配置步骤。

say.text: 给我加上 Discord 机器人通道
say.note: 会开始复制适配器、注册频道并引导你填 Bot Token。

say.text: 把 Discord 接到我所在的服务器
在 /setup 里添加 Discord 频道

howto.what_en: After installation the assistant gains a Discord bot channel through the Chat SDK bridge: the bot can DM you and exchange messages in text channels of a server you share; threads are supported.
howto.when_en: The skill runs when you explicitly ask to add Discord bot integration or choose Discord as a channel in the /setup flow.

say_en.note: Produces the invite link so the bot joins a server you also belong to.
Installs, validates credentials, and restarts the service.
